web_facts = await web_search("site:en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Moon minimum perigee 356400 km")

I’m also checking the marathon record page to ensure the pace input is the record-making time requested.
```python
marathon_facts = await web_search("site:en.wikipedia.org Eliud Kipchoge marathon world record 2:01:09")
print(marathon_facts)
```
Using the verified inputs—356400 km and a 2:01:09 marathon—I’m calculating the travel time and rounding to the nearest 1000 hours.
```python
travel_time = await calculator("round(356400 / (42.195 / (2 + 1/60 + 9/3600)) / 1000) * 1000")
print(travel_time)
```
17000 hours
